Coram : ARUN MISHRA*, S. ABDUL NAZEER, M.R. SHAH
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996: s. 31(7)(b) – Reduction of rate of interest – Arbitral award along with interest payable in accordance with s. 31(7(b), at the rate of 18% pa – District judge reduced the rate of interest on the sum awarded from 18% to 6% of s. 24 of the UP Amendment Act – Upheld by the High Court – On appeal, held: Section 31(7)(b) clearly states that unless otherwise specified, the awarded sum would carry an interest @ 18% pa – Para 7-A of s. 24 of the U.P. Amendment Act was an amendment to the First Schedule
Decision Date : 08-08-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3559/2010 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
